findings.summary: The authoritative acceptance criterion 'promoter tick loaded/base <= 1.20 (<=+20% of base)' is NOT met. QA independently reproduced tick_ratio 1.27 and 1.36 in 2 of 4 B=16 runs on real aqb-valkey (:16379), 100k entries, 3,333 hb/s. The implementer's own evidence (2026-11-05-change.md §3b/§3c) and AI-log iteration 4 concur the target is not proven (B=16 ~1.35) and was escalated. Passes only on noise-favourable runs.
findings.rule: Task text 'fix the promoter-tick slowdown to <=+20% of base ... PROVEN with the load test'; design.md §4.6 'Pass gate: with B=16, loaded/base <= 1.20'; owner message #12 'slowndown arent alllowed'.
findings.reproduction: cd services/queue && RUN_HEARTBEAT_LOAD=1 QUEUE_LIVENESS_SHARDS=16 TEST_VALKEY_SERVER='[{"host":"localhost","port":16379}]' go test -tags integration -run TestHeartbeatLoad -v -count=1 ./internal/queue/infrastructure/valkey/ -> tick_ratio logged > 1.20 on repeat runs (expected <= 1.20).

findings.summary: The required proof no longer exists as an executable gate: TestHeartbeatLoad does not assert loaded/base <= 1.20; for shards>1 it asserts duringMed < 2500us (absolute) and marginal < 1200us only, with the ratio 'logged for transparency only'. The gate was redefined to 'option A' (absolute+marginal), recorded in ADR-030 Amendment §2, TP TC-ANON-05, and evidence §3d as a 'keputusan pemilik 2026-11-05 opsi A'. No such owner ratification exists in the authoritative owner messages (#1-#12); the last relevant message (#12) 'slowndown arent alllowed' does not relax the <=+20% line. The AI-log shows the choice was escalated (iter 4) then asserted as decided (iter 4b) without a traceable owner yes.
findings.rule: Task text 'PROVE it with the load test'; QA must verify the stated requirement, not a redefined one; human-gate/learnings principle that acceptance-criterion changes are the owner's explicit, traceable call.
findings.reproduction: grep -n 'assert' services/queue/internal/queue/infrastructure/valkey/heartbeat_load_integration_test.go -> assertions are duringMed<2500us and marginal<1200us; no loaded/base<=1.20 assertion.

findings.summary: Implementation deviates from 'the approach in the design': design §4.3/§4.4 specifies sharded hb with the sweep fanning out liveness.lua once per shard; the shipped code collapses the tick into a single-round-trip liveness_tick.lua (new script, not named in the design) plus a single-EVAL all-shard liveness.lua. Defensible and it is the real source of the absolute-latency win, but it is a different mechanism than the cited design and still misses the design's own <=1.20 gate. Reconcile when the acceptance criterion is settled.
findings.rule: Task text 'via the approach in the design'; design.md §4.3/§4.4 (per-shard fan-out) vs shipped liveness_tick.lua single round-trip.
findings.reproduction: ls services/queue/assets/lua/liveness_tick.lua (exists, not in design); test calls SweepLivenessTick (one round-trip), design §4.3 describes SweepLiveness per-shard fan-out.

findings.summary: Makefile line 15 default TEST_VALKEY_SERVER points at :6379 (forbidden shared Redis); a bare 'make ci' runs the cover integration stage against the wrong server. 'make ci green' is only valid with TEST_VALKEY_SERVER overridden to aqb-valkey :16379. Not introduced by this change; pre-existing pkg/rabbitmq flake is out of scope and not counted as a gate failure.
